summary: Frontend-only verification of Lab Phase 4 (BIOS post-reboot mini-lab, stutter score chips, latency, session history + regression). All target data-testids and behaviors validated. Report shows +15.85% gain with per-step '1% low ±X%' chips on all 7 steps; no 'ms lat' chip and no lab-report-latency element (correct, this report has no latency data). Insights card renders lab-insight-bios_rebar with 'Did you enable Resizable BAR?' + lab-check-start-bios_rebar button. History card shows 11 rows: 9 LAB (yellow) + 2 CHECK (cyan) badges, one CHECK with red 'REGRESSION' badge, one CHECK with 'Resizable BAR verification' reason. Positive gains rendered green. Mini-lab flow: clicking lab-check-start-bios_rebar creates session, shows 'Verification mini-lab' title + StatusPill 'Waiting for agent' + ConnectCard. Header lab-abort-btn IS present in waiting_agent (contrary to the request note, but matches code: shown when active && !aborting). Clicking Abort transitions to lab-aborted-card with rollback message; Nuova sessione returns to setup showing SetupCard + InsightsCard + HistoryCard together. EN language switch translates 'Automatic Performance Lab', 'Suggested checks', 'Session history', 'Verification mini-lab', 'Waiting for agent', 'I enabled it — verify' etc. No raw i18n keys detected.

issues: 3 console errors at initial load (401 on /agent/token or similar while auth cookie resolves) — cosmetic, already flagged in iteration_46

action_items: OPTIONAL: The request note said 'in waiting_agent NON c'è il pulsante abort header' — the current code DOES show lab-abort-btn in header for any active session (waiting_agent included), because `active && status !== 'aborting'` includes waiting_agent. This actually worked in favor of the abort flow (we could abort with the header button), but the spec note is out of sync with the implementation. Decide which is intended.
critical_code_review_comments: Lab.jsx is now 734 lines and still bundles ~13 sub-components (SetupCard, ConnectCard, RebootBanner, SynergyCard, ValidationBlock, BaselineCard, Timeline, LogFeed, BiosSuggestions, ShareCard, ReportCard, InsightsCard, HistoryCard, CheckProgress, CheckResultCard). Split into /pages/Lab/components/* — file has grown ~170 lines since iteration_46 without refactor.

InsightsCard/HistoryCard fetch on every mount (each time the user returns to needSetup or showReport). Consider lifting the two GETs into the parent so they run once per Lab visit and share loading state.

Header abort button visibility rule (`active && status !== 'aborting'`) may conflict with the intended UX (per review note: abort should only appear for truly active sessions, not waiting_agent). Consider excluding waiting_agent from the actions header if that's the intent.
seed_data_creation: None — used the pre-seeded sessions (last=Lab +15.85%, 2 check sessions incl. regression + rebar, 8 more Lab sessions).
